programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany is hurt before a major school event in 'The Temp', and in 'Parent Trap', Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, so Alvin gets Dave's help, bringing heated competion. (S2, ep 18)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them. (S5, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it. (S1, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit! (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his destiny in 'Theodore's Calling', then in 'Clumsy Jeanette', Jeanette's new glasses cause a clumsy change. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin wants the lead role in a play in 'Best in Shoe', then in 'Royal Pain', Brittany becomes convinced she's a long lost princess, and carries her new royal status a little too far. (S4, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a film in 'Lights Camera Uh-Oh', then in 'Wax Dave', The Chipmunks fear Dave is in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a statue! (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin agrees not to speak for 24 hours in 'Spoiler-Itis', then in 'Something's Fishy', when Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they try to replace it before he notices. (S3, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats in 'The Cat Sitter', then in 'Addicted', The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul-mate in 'Albrittina', then in 'Simon for President', Simon and Alvin decide to launch their own campaigns for class president. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Pirates show up at the house in 'Pirates Life', then in 'World Record', The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game. (S4, ep 6)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The chipmunks think Dave is in danger in 'The Exchange Student', then in 'Crystal Ball Birthday', Annie and Amber plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor. (S4, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The girls are remembering their home in 'The Tree House', then in 'Saving Simon', Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to a boarding school, and try to keep him at home. (S1, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room in 'A Room of One's Own', then in 'Carts and Crafts', Alvin inadvertently destroys Theodore's bicycle, so enters a contest to win a new bike. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy in 'Baby Mama Drama', then in 'Ballet Boys', when Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help their skills. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
